pr.title: Show each pull request's age on its line, and line its drawer up with the number
pr.head: b29723fdd851949bc98729ef6ebef0ffe9f8ad3b

summary: Projector's band is the strip its Claude Code plugin draws above the prompt. It lists the pull requests the session's review and watch loops track, one line each, and below them the session's inbox: questions and notices that agents posted for you. Each inbox item's line already ended with how long ago it was posted, such as 5m. Clicking a pull request's number opens its drawer, a few lines under it with the pull request's facts and links.

Before this change, a pull request's line did not say how long ago the pull request changed. That age sat at the end of the drawer, one click away, though it is what tells you whether a loop is still making progress. This change ends each pull request's line with that age, in the same right-aligned column as the items' ages.
The change also reshapes the drawer in two ways:

• It starts under the number. It used to start under the title, which indented its lines for no reason under a short title.
  • Each link has a line of its own. github and projector used to share a line with discuss. A terminal without hyperlink support draws a link's URL after its text, so on a shared line the first URL pushed the second link off the edge.
Only hooks/register.tsx changes behavior. The rest is one updated and one new test, the band examples in docs/plugins.md, and a record of the three changes in § 10 of the inbox plan.

cards.title: Terms
cards.html:
• Band: the strip above the Claude Code prompt that lists tracked pull requests and inbox items.
  • Item: a question or notice an agent posted to the inbox, shown as a line in the band.
  • Drawer: the lines that open under a pull request or item when you click it.
  • Age: how long ago something happened, in short form such as 45s, 5m, or 7h.

groups.title: The pull request line and its drawer
groups.kicker: One age column for pull requests and items, and a drawer that starts under the number
intro: The band draws each pull request as a row: its number, draft or ready, the title, and any notes such as conflict. Each inbox item's row ended with its age in a column as wide as the widest item age, so the items' pull request labels lined up. This change widens that column to cover pull requests too: the width is the widest of every pull request's updatedAt age and every shown item's postedAt age, and both kinds of row draw it through one helper, ageColumn.

For the age to land at the right edge, the title now grows to fill its row, as an item's subject already did. A pull request that GitHub gave no update time for draws an empty column of the same width, so the rows still line up.
The drawer loses its left margin, drawerIndent, and its "updated … ago" fact, since the row now shows the age. discuss keeps a row of its own, and the github and projector links each take a line.

checks.text: Both band tests the change touches fail when hooks/register.tsx is put back to the base version and pass at the head; claude plugin test . passed 73 of 73 at the code's head.

files.note: The band's renderer: the shared age column, the growing title, and the drawer's new layout.

checks.text: updatedAt is number | null, and hooks/github.ts turns an unparseable time into null, so ageOf never passes NaN to span. secondsSince clamps a time in the future to zero.

The width counts every listed pull request and every shown item, so when an item's drawer has the band to itself, its age column can be wider than its own age. The age stays right-aligned; the item's subject has a column less room to show.
A pull request's age box is keyed age:owner/repo#n and an item's age:item:<ref>, so the keys never collide.
Nothing else read the removed drawerIndent, and the divider still uses ago.
